row.title: STICKY-1: audience is measured as visitor-days and daily feed readers
row.body: The analytics beacon keeps nothing in the browser and visitor ids rotate daily (guard in seed/worker/test/analytics.test.js), so the step counts visitor-days from hits and daily feed readers (hits name feed, recorded server-side by the site worker). return_rate is computed only from a real returning count a system serves at audience_url, otherwise it reads unmeasured. Verified by seed/worker/test/stickiness.test.js.
